title: A Night at WISDOM: Coastal Flavours & Lounge Glow
excerpt: From charcoal-grilled barracuda to signature cocktails — how we set the table for Limbe evenings.
content:
At WISDOM, dinner is never just a meal. It is the soft teal light on silver glassware, the smell of citrus butter on fresh fish, and the first sip of a lounge cocktail as the night opens.

Our kitchen leans into Cameroonian classics — ndolè, plantain, coastal seafood — plated with modern restraint. Ask for the Chef's Special when you visit; it changes with the season.

After dinner, step into the lounge. Same menu, deeper drinks list, and a soundtrack that carries until late.

title: Spa Tips: How to Prep for Your First Facial
excerpt: Arrive hydrated, skip heavy makeup, and leave with glow that lasts — our facialists share simple prep advice.
content:
Your first facial at WISDOM should feel like a reset, not a rush. Arrive a few minutes early, drink water, and skip heavy foundation so our technicians can see your skin clearly.

We use products available in our shop — including Teal Glow Face Oil — so you can continue the ritual at home.

Book via WhatsApp with your preferred date and time. Pricing varies by stylist level.

title: Behind the Scenes: Building the Bride Package
excerpt: Hair, nails, facial, and calm — why we designed a full bridal morning under one roof.
content:
Weddings in Limbe move fast. Our Bride Package gathers hair, a makeup-ready facial, manicure, and pedicure so you can stay in one place and breathe.

Couples often add Couples Day the weekend before — massage, scrub, and sauna for two.
